entities.summary: Dominic Thiem is an Austrian former professional tennis player. He was ranked world No. 3 in singles by the ATP, achieved in March 2020. Thiem won 17 ATP Tour-level singles titles, including the 2020 US Open. He was also runner-up at three other majors, and at the 2019 and 2020 ATP Finals.
